camera.projection: flat-facet 3/4, z-buffered, ordered dither (4x4 Bayer), depth-edge darkening, no AA, binary alpha

bake.cells: TWO: flatbed28/reefer28 bake in the 384x320 road cell @ 192,214; flatbed53/reefer53 take 640x480 @ 320,300 (16.15 m projects both up- and down-screen). render() returns the BODY’S cell — read cellFor(body).
bake.facing_note: dir 0 (N) shows the REAR (reefer doors / flatbed tail + ICC); dir 4 (S) shows the NOSE, kingpin end. The trailers bake at coupled ride height with the gear down.
bake.body_note: body is a SPAWN parameter: {body:’flatbed28’|’flatbed53’|’reefer28’|’reefer53’}. Default reefer53.

handshake._what: the coupling numbers BOTH tractors’ swing margins depend on — asserted in this kit’s harness AND both tractor harnesses
handshake.kingpin_anchor: anchors().kingpin = [0, L/2-0.90, 1.18] per body — hinge it to a tractor’s anchors().fifthWheel
handshake.rule: keep the set at 0.90 and the width at 2.44 — they ARE the 4 mm jackknife margin

gear.sense: 0 legs up (COUPLED) -> 1 legs down, shoes grounded (PARKED, the default)

doors.fan: through FULL OUTBOARD (|x| 2.37) at 180deg, parked along the sides at 255deg (2.60 m overall)
doors.flatbeds: clamped to 0 — no doors on a flatbed

roll.cyclic: one revolution closes to 0-1 px (29.008 tread stripes; 10-lug hubs with FIVE hand-holes so half a rev is visible)

sus.formula: dz(y) = -(sus*0.10) * max(0,(kingpinY-y)/(kingpinY-axleCentreY)) — pivots at the KINGPIN; the coupling plane holds 1.18

yaw.what: rebaked heading under the fixed key; the pivot never moves

parts.headboard: flatbeds only, default true — zero swept volume

articulation.steering: NONE — towed bodies. Heading comes from the hinge; off-tracking inputs are in the handshake block.

night.effect: reefer unit grille glows; marker lamps stay lit ramps

weather.effect: grime, rust, plank wear — the WOOD deck weathers with the steel

anchors._units: {x,y} in THIS body’s cell px, m = [x,y,z] model metres
{x,y} in THIS body’s cell px, m = [x,y,z] model metres
{x,y} in THIS body’s cell px, m = [x,y,z] model metres
{x,y} in THIS body’s cell px, m = [x,y,z] model metres

sheets.pose: the ten harbour paints at SE, weather 0.22
gear cue 0->1 at W — legs down to the shoes
doors cue 0->255deg at N — out, through full outboard, flat to the sides
